memo: New part ae (ours; idea credited to heliosli's r3p overlay in the public casmi26-0-481, whose site model and library are private): after the 0.480 final merge, analogs in the same mode/adduct whose precursor differs by one natural-product modification (his 19 + our H2/NH) with modified cosine >= 0.95 vote for their single-edit products (our own library index built in-kernel from train.parquet, all 10 adducts); products already in the list or the pipeline's pools are skipped; the winner (ties by our fragment explanation) goes to rank 2 only when the new products are <= 4 or two analogs agree. Rank 1 and the rest unchanged. Simulation 11-04 (3,000 enveda-180 structures hidden from the library): gate 19%, hit 11% of gated (0.20 when <= 4 products / 0.29 with 2 votes, 0.06 with many); visible test: 28/400 molecules get an insertion. Effect estimate: about 9 public molecules touched, ~0.1 hit rate on hidden class 3 -> +0.45 minus ~0.23 cost = about +0.2 public molecules (range -0.3 to +1): below 2, so bundled on the np bundle (m480 + ownco + lfrag + onp; c1r dropped: -0.001). Hypothesis: LB >= 0.481. build.py m480ae base=p477 outer=m480 ownco=1 lfrag=1 onp=1 ae=1.
